title: MD5 — technical profile
description: MD5 is a 128-bit hash function designed by Ron Rivest in 1991 and specified in RFC 1321. Xiaoyun Wang's team demonstrated practical collisions in 2004, and chosen-prefix collisions followed in 2007.
